name: 60068 · Park Ridge, IL
findings: ZIP 60068 (Park Ridge) has 179 nonprofit organizations. 89 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 79 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (17% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60068 (Park Ridge) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
35% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 60068 (Park Ridge) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 60 organizations here; 45% of all organizations here have no identified type.
